open_decisions.name: enrollmentAndRetention
open_decisions.where: Out-of-band admin device/source issuance and PRD retention defaults
open_decisions.why: No public enrollment/rotation/logout wire flow approved; retention defaults require privacy owner approval.
open_decisions.decision: Approve admin issuance/revocation ownership, source/device lifecycle, explicit empty-selection consent and dated retention decisions.
open_decisions.rationale: Owner blanket authorization permits this bounded planning default; it does not decide unspecified lifecycle wire fields or supply dated privacy-owner retention approval.
open_decisions.choice: Use the proposed device-to-owner credential registry for the first release and defer OAuth user enrollment until needed; retain controlled out-of-band administration and no public enrollment/rotation/logout wire API.
open_decisions.choice_scope: Bounded initial auth strategy only; no wire fields added and no complete resolution of this compound decision.
remaining_confirmation: Admin issuance/revocation responsibility and source/device lifecycle details
Dated privacy-owner approval of all retention policies, including backup expiry
open_decisions.resolution_detail: Device-to-owner credential registry for first release; owner-controlled audited admin issuance/revocation; no public enrollment API; explicit selection with empty selection capturing nothing. Retention: acknowledged mobile content <=24h; pending <=30 days/10000 rows/50MiB with no silent eviction; backend raw until user deletion; location seven days and disabled; online deletion <=24h with immediate tombstone; backups 30 days; derived data cannot outlive its supporting permission.
